name: @ozjsey/v-teleport-to
description: Vue 3 directive for viewport-aware fixed positioning relative to a reference element — escapes overflow containers
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vTeleportTo.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vTeleportTo.js dist/vTeleportTo.min.js && mv dist/vTeleportTo.js.map dist/vTeleportTo.min.js.map && mv dist/vTeleportTo.cjs dist/vTeleportTo.min.cjs && mv dist/vTeleportTo.cjs.map dist/vTeleportTo.min.cjs.map && mv dist/vTeleportTo.d.cts dist/vTeleportTo.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['vTeleportTo.min.js','vTeleportTo.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=vTeleportTo\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
